card.title: How To Repair an iPhone 15 Pro Max Error 9 Caused Due To Aftermarket BackGlass

source.title: How To Repair an iPhone 15 Pro Max Error 9 Caused Due To Aftermarket BackGlass

claims.statement: iPhone 15 Pro / Pro Max restores failing with error 9 can be caused by an aftermarket back glass wireless charging flex interfering with USB-C data; restoring succeeds with that flex unplugged.
Aftermarket flexes often have lighter/golden traces, thinner copper and no Apple labels; fit an OEM pulled flex.

procedure: Confirm back glass was replaced; inspect the flex.
Restore with the wireless charging flex disconnected.
Fit an OEM wireless charging flex; test charging, NFC, MagSafe.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
